rows.name: page
rows.allows: Pages, each with an item in the menu.

rows.name: style
rows.allows: Rules in the stylesheet, for names that the plugin registers.

rows.name: script
rows.allows: A script file that a page of the plugin may load.

rows.name: network:same-origin
rows.allows: A script that asks the site's own server for data.

rows.name: check
rows.allows: Rules of its own in the check.

rows.name: asset
rows.allows: Another file in the built site, such as a template.

rows.name: third-party
rows.allows: Files from another project, each listed with its checksum.
